raw_response:
The issuer shows adequate liquidity (current ratio 1.39), positive profitability (EBIT of 886M on 9,143M revenue), and a meaningful equity base (21,312M, about 29% of assets), which supports credit quality. However, leverage is still fairly high relative to earnings and the absence of retained earnings limits balance-sheet cushion, keeping the profile toward the low end of investment grade.

DECISION: BBB-
